points.description: Names and correctly describes the first valid challenge of mobile routing (e.g. adaptation to dynamic topology/nodes joining or leaving, security, medium access control such as hidden/exposed/near-far terminals, QoS, scalability, heterogeneity, dependability, or power consumption).
points.partial_credit: Half of this point's marks if the challenge is named correctly but the description is missing or vague.

points.description: Names and correctly describes a second, different valid challenge from the same kind of list. Equivalent wording is accepted; it must be distinct from the first challenge.
points.partial_credit: Half of this point's marks if the challenge is named correctly but the description is missing or vague.
